select 'orders' src, strategy k, min(created_at)::date lo, max(created_at)::date hi, count(*) n
  from live_orders where side = 'no' and action = 'buy' group by strategy
union all
select 'cand_ticks', 'all', min(captured_at)::date, max(captured_at)::date, count(*) from mmsell_candidate_ticks
union all
select 'pos_ticks', 'all', min(captured_at)::date, max(captured_at)::date, count(*) from mmsell_position_ticks
union all
select 'trade_ev', 'all', min(received_at)::date, max(received_at)::date, count(*) from execution_trade_events
union all
select 'fill_ev', 'all', min(received_at)::date, max(received_at)::date, count(*) from execution_fill_events
union all
select 'cancel', coalesce(cancel_reason, status), min(created_at)::date, max(created_at)::date, count(*)
  from live_orders where strategy = 'Fmmsell10' group by coalesce(cancel_reason, status)
order by 1, 3
